# bicep/main.bicep

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Entra ID-only, Intune-managed, private-by-default Azure Virtual Desktop landing zone for greenfield deployments.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `namePrefix` | string |  | Short workload prefix (lowercase letters/digits, 2-8 chars). Resource names derive from this. |
| `environmentName` | string |  | Environment. Drives naming and a few safe-by-default toggles. |
| `location` | string | `deployment().location` | Azure region for all regional resources. |
| `tags` | object | `{}` | Extra tags merged onto every resource group and resource. |
| `avdUsersGroupObjectId` | string |  | Object ID of the Entra ID security group whose members get the desktop (Desktop Virtualization User, VM User Login, SMB Share Contributor). |
| `avdAdminsGroupObjectId` | string |  | Object ID of the Entra ID security group of AVD operators (VM Administrator Login, SMB Share Elevated Contributor, Key Vault Secrets User). |
| `avdServicePrincipalObjectId` | string |  | Object ID of the Azure Virtual Desktop service principal in this tenant (app ID (ID in the source)). Needed for autoscale and Start VM on Connect. deploy.sh looks it up for you. |
| `enrollInIntune` | bool | `true` | Enroll session hosts in Microsoft Intune as part of the Entra join. |
| `connectivityMode` | string | `'Standalone'` | Standalone = self-contained spoke with NAT Gateway egress and local private DNS zones. HubPeered = peer to an existing hub, force egress through its firewall, use its DNS. |
| `spokeAddressPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Address space for the AVD spoke VNet. |
| `sessionHostSubnetPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Session host subnet (inside the spoke). /23 = ~500 hosts. |
| `privateEndpointSubnetPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Private endpoint subnet (inside the spoke). |
| `deployImageBuildSubnets` | bool | `false` | Add the golden image build subnets to this spoke (build/specs/image-pipeline-spec.md). Only the image build environment needs them; off by default. |
| `imageBuildSubnetPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Image build VM subnet (inside the spoke). |
| `imageBuildAciSubnetPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Image build container subnet, delegated to Azure Container Instances (inside the spoke). |
| `hubVnetResourceId` | string | `''` | HubPeered only: resource ID of the hub VNet. |
| `createHubToSpokePeering` | bool | `true` | HubPeered only: create the hub-to-spoke side of the peering too. Requires Network Contributor on the hub VNet for the deploying identity. |
| `hubFirewallPrivateIp` | string | `''` | HubPeered only: private IP of the hub firewall/NVA. 0.0.0.0/0 from the session host subnet is routed here. |
| `dnsServers` | array | `[]` | Custom DNS servers for the spoke (e.g. hub firewall DNS proxy or Private DNS Resolver inbound IP). Empty = Azure-provided DNS. |
| `centralPrivateDnsZoneResourceIds` | object | `{}` |  |
| `enableAvdPrivateLink` | bool | `true` | Use Private Link for the AVD host pool connection (session hosts reach the AVD service privately; clients still connect over the internet). |
| `sessionHostCount` | int | `2` | Number of session hosts. |
| `sessionHostVmSize` | string | `'Standard_E4as_v5'` | Session host VM size. Memory-optimized E-series by default: multi-session hosts run out of memory before CPU (8 GiB per vCPU, against 4 on D-series). Check vCPU quota (the Easv5 family) and zonal availability first. |
| `sessionHostNamePrefix` | string | `take('${toLower(replace(namePrefix, '-', ''))}${take(environmentName, 1)}sh', 11)` | Session host name prefix (max 11 chars; a 3-digit index is appended to stay within the 15-char Windows limit). |
| `availabilityZones` | int[] | `(see the file)` | Availability zones to spread session hosts across. Empty array = regional (no zones). |
| `sessionHostImage` | object | `(see the file)` | Marketplace image for session hosts. Replace with an Azure Compute Gallery image when you have an image pipeline. |
| `sessionHostImageId` | string | `''` | Azure Compute Gallery image version resource ID for session hosts, from the image pipeline (build/specs/image-pipeline-spec.md section 6.1). A version, never a definition or latest, so nothing changes software silently. Empty: the marketplace image above. |
| `sessionHostGeneration` | string | `''` | Host generation for blue/green rotation: empty keeps the original host names; a or b gives take(sessionHostNamePrefix, 10) + the generation, so the two generations never collide. Only the rotation script changes it. |
| `hostPoolStateTags` | object | `{}` |  |
| `maxSessionLimit` | int | `8` | Maximum sessions per host (breadth-first). Size to your workload. |
| `encryptionAtHost` | bool | `true` | Enable encryption at host. Requires the Microsoft.Compute/EncryptionAtHost feature on the subscription (deploy.sh registers it). |
| `localAdminUsername` | string | `'avdbreakglass'` | Break-glass local administrator name. Day-to-day admin access is via Entra ID (VM Administrator Login). |
| `localAdminPassword` | string |  | Break-glass local administrator password, applied when a host is created and stored in Key Vault. deploy.sh generates a random one unless AVD_LOCAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD is set; never commit it. |
| `rdpProperties` | string | `'enablerdsaadauth:i:1;targetisaadjoined:i:1;drivestoredirect:s:;usbdevicestoredirect:s:;redirectcomports:i:0;redirectsmartcards:i:1;redirectprinters:i:1;redirectclipboard:i:1;redirectwebauthn:i:1;audiomode:i:0;audiocapturemode:i:1;camerastoredirect:s:*;use multimon:i:1'` | RDP properties for the host pool. Defaults: Entra SSO on; drive, COM and USB redirection off. |
| `validationEnvironment` | bool | `environmentName != 'prod'` | Mark the host pool as a validation pool (gets AVD service updates first). Recommended for non-prod. |
| `profileStorageSku` | string | `'Premium_ZRS'` | Premium Azure Files redundancy. ZRS where the region supports it. |
| `profileShareQuotaGiB` | int | `1024` | Provisioned size of the profile share in GiB. On Premium, IOPS and throughput scale with this number. |
| `fslogixProfileSizeMiB` | int | `30720` | Maximum size of each FSLogix profile container in MiB. |
| `enableProfileBackup` | bool | `true` | Back up the profile share with Azure Backup. |
| `profileBackupRetentionDays` | int | `30` | Daily backup retention for the profile share, in days. |
| `profileBackupTier` | string | `'Snapshot'` | Profile backup tier (build/specs/recovery-spec.md). Snapshot: snapshots kept in the share, lost with it. Vaulted: copies kept in the Recovery Services vault, the offsite copy; Azure Backup then needs storage account key access, so the profile storage account allows it (SMB stays Kerberos-only). |
| `startVmOnConnect` | bool | `true` | Start a deallocated session host when a user connects (Start VM on Connect). Off: users can only connect while the scaling plan keeps hosts running, and hosts run longer (cost). |
| `scalingTimeZone` | string | `'UTC'` | Time zone for the autoscale schedule (Windows time zone ID). |
| `logRetentionDays` | int | `90` | Log Analytics retention in days. |
| `alertEmailAddresses` | string[] | `[]` | Email addresses for alerts and budget notifications. |
| `monthlyBudgetAmount` | int | `0` | Monthly budget for the subscription in billing currency. 0 = no budget. |
| `budgetStartDate` | string | `''` | Budget start date (first of a month, yyyy-MM-01). Required when monthlyBudgetAmount > 0. Keep it fixed across deployments. |
| `enableAutoShutdown` | bool | `true` | Deploy the auto-shutdown runbook: it stops the session hosts on a schedule and stops or locks them when the budget is exceeded. |
| `autoShutdownTime` | string | `''` | Time to stop the session hosts on the scheduled days (HH:mm, in autoShutdownTimeZone). Empty = no scheduled stop (the scaling plan still scales down). |
| `autoShutdownDays` | string[] | `(see the file)` | Days the scheduled stop runs. |
| `autoShutdownTimeZone` | string | `scalingTimeZone` | Windows time zone name for autoShutdownTime. |
| `autoShutdownScheduleAction` | string | `'Stop'` | What the scheduled stop does: Stop deallocates idle hosts; Lock keeps every host off until Resume. |
| `autoShutdownBudgetAction` | string | `'Lock'` | What a budget alert does: Lock keeps every host off until someone runs Resume; Stop deallocates idle hosts; None = no budget trigger. Needs the budget (monthlyBudgetAmount, budgetStartDate, alertEmailAddresses). |
| `autoShutdownBudgetPercent` | int | `100` | Percentage of the monthly budget (actual cost) that triggers autoShutdownBudgetAction. |
| `autoShutdownRunbookUri` | string | `'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nickprignano/avd-landing-zone/master/scripts/automation/Invoke-AvdPowerAction.ps1'` | Where Automation downloads the runbook from. deploy.sh pins it to the commit being deployed (AVD_RUNBOOK_URI). |
| `deployJumpbox` | bool | `false` | Add an operator jumpbox: a small Linux or Windows Server VM in the spoke with the Cloud Shell toolchain, reached in the browser through Azure Bastion Developer (no charge, no public IP). Off by default. Bastion Developer exists only in some regions (Get-AvdBastionDeveloperRegion). |
| `jumpboxSubnetPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | Jumpbox subnet (inside the spoke). |
| `jumpboxOs` | string | `'Linux'` | Jumpbox operating system: Linux (Ubuntu 24.04, the default) or Windows (Windows Server 2025). |
| `jumpboxVmSize` | string | `''` | Jumpbox VM size. Empty: the smallest burstable size with room for PowerShell and the Az modules, Standard_B2als_v2 (2 vCPUs, 4 GiB) for Linux and Standard_B2as_v2 (8 GiB) for Windows. |
| `jumpboxAutoShutdownTime` | string | `'2000'` | Daily stop of the jumpbox (HHmm, in autoShutdownTimeZone). It always has one unless jumpboxKeepRunningUntil is set (avd-second-brain decision 0017). |
| `jumpboxKeepRunningUntil` | string | `''` | Keep the jumpbox running past its daily stop until this UTC time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ), recorded on the avdlz-keep-running-until tag of the VM. Empty: the daily stop applies. |
| `jumpboxExists` | bool | `false` | The jumpbox VM already exists (deploy.sh sets it). Then only its daily stop and tags are updated: Azure refuses a change to the custom data and admin password of an existing VM. |
| `jumpboxAdminPassword` | string | `newGuid()` | Password of the local account on the jumpbox. Random per deployment and applied only when the VM is created; nobody knows it. scripts/ops/Connect-AvdJumpbox.ps1 sets a one-time password on each connect. |
| `enableDefenderForCloud` | bool | `true` | Enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud plans (Servers P2, Storage, Key Vault) on the subscription. |
| `deploySubscriptionSettings` | bool | `true` | Deploy the subscription-wide pieces: the policy guardrails (when enablePolicyGuardrails) and the activity log export. One landing zone per subscription owns them; a second one beside it (parameters/test.bicepparam) sets this to false. |
| `enablePolicyGuardrails` | bool | `true` |  |
| `recoveryLocation` | string | `''` | Recovery region (build/specs/recovery-spec.md): a second region the guardrails also allow, for restores and recovery tests. Empty: none, and the guardrails allow only location. |
| `allowedLocations` | string[] | `union([location], empty(recoveryLocation) ? [] : [recoveryLocation])` | Allowed regions for resources and resource groups when policy guardrails are on. The default is location plus recoveryLocation when set. |
